examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The cog button opens a dialog with page size, the columns (show, hide and move up or down; a locked column always shows), wrap lines, striped rows and density. Nothing changes until Confirm; Cancel, Esc and the close button discard the draft.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CollectionPreferences from '@aziontech/webkit/collection-preferences'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const columns = [
    { id: 'name', label: 'Name', locked: true },
    { id: 'status', label: 'Status' },
    { id: 'region', label: 'Region' },
    { id: 'requests', label: 'Requests' }
  ]

  const preferences = ref({
    pageSize: 25,
    columns: [
      { id: 'name', visible: true },
      { id: 'status', visible: true },
      { id: 'region', visible: false },
      { id: 'requests', visible: true }
    ],
    wrapLines: false,
    striped: false,
    density: 'comfortable'
  })
</script>

<template>
  <CollectionPreferences
    v-model:preferences="preferences"
    :columns="columns"
    :page-size-options="[10, 25, 50, 100]"
  />
</template>

examples.name: InADrawer
examples.summary: `container="drawer"` opens the panel from the side, `sections` keeps only the columns and the density, and the `trigger` slot replaces the cog with a labelled button.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import CollectionPreferences from '@aziontech/webkit/collection-preferences'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const columns = [
    { id: 'name', label: 'Name', locked: true },
    { id: 'domain', label: 'Domain' },
    { id: 'status', label: 'Status' }
  ]

  const preferences = ref({ density: 'compact' })
</script>

<template>
  <CollectionPreferences
    v-model:preferences="preferences"
    :columns="columns"
    :sections="['columns', 'density']"
    container="drawer"
  >
    <template #trigger="{ open }">
      <Button
        label="Table settings"
        icon="pi pi-cog"
        kind="outlined"
        size="medium"
        @click="open"
      />
    </template>
  </CollectionPreferences>
</template>
